rederived.what: re-derived B425's twisted Alexander at rho_geo with an INDEPENDENT instrument (generic Fox calculus on snappy's own presentation + SL2C, Wada-normalised) and reproduced its exact values at n=0,1,2,3 up to the unit -1. B425's COMPUTATIONS ARE CONFIRMED, including at odd n which B425 never ran. What is SCOPED is its conclusion 'sqrt(-3) cancels in every determinant': that holds at rho_geo of m004 BECAUSE m004 IS AMPHICHIRAL, and fails for chiral manifolds -- all 8 chiral members of m004's commensurability class keep sqrt(-3) at every n, as do all 8 chiral knot complements tested. The cancellation is an amphichirality artefact, not a general fact.

claim_one_line: THE OWNER'S CATCH WAS RIGHT: B425'S 'sqrt(-3) CANCELS' IS AN AMPHICHIRALITY ARTEFACT, AND xB009 TESTED THE ONE OBJECT WHERE THE QUESTION IS DEGENERATE (PREREGISTRATION sealed sha256 642ccf4e... and PUSHED at 4b16b19 BEFORE any cell ran). xB009 ran B425's Fox calculus on the figure-eight relator ALONE and compared TWO manifolds, yet claimed the SECTOR -- the E70 shape. THREE DEFECTS OF THIS SEAT'S OWN WERE CAUGHT BY F1's CONTROLS BEFORE ANY VERDICT: (1) the un-normalised Fox determinant is not an invariant (B425's own guard section says so), so Wada normalisation was added; (2) the abelianisation is NOT the total exponent sum -- snappy's m004 relator aaabABBAb has exponent vector (a:1, b:0) so alpha must send a->0, b->1, computed from the relator kernel now; (3) SNAPPY'S SL2C LIFT SENDS THE m004 RELATOR TO -I, NOT +I, so Sym^odd o rho IS NOT A REPRESENTATION for that lift and every odd-n number from it is VOID -- the lift is repaired over F_2, and this is why a first numerical pass appeared to contradict B425. B425 WAS RIGHT AND THE INSTRUMENT WAS WRONG. F1 PASS: the repaired instrument reproduces B425's exact values at n=0,1,2,3 up to the unit -1, INCLUDING AT ODD n WHICH B425 NEVER RAN, so xB009's m004 finding is independently CONFIRMED. F2: the Q(sqrt-3) commensurability class, 16 usable of 21 (5 excluded for H_1 rank 2, two cusps -- REPORTED, not dropped). F3, ONE WAY AND ONLY ONE WAY: CHIRAL ==> sqrt(-3) SURVIVES, 8 of 8, no exception; THE CONVERSE IS FALSE -- amphichirality does NOT imply cancellation, since m004 is real at all n, m003 and s955 at even n only, and m206, m207, s957, s960, s961 are complex everywhere. So B425's cancellation is an AMPHICHIRALITY ARTEFACT and xB009's headline was the over-reach the owner suspected: correct for m004, FALSE as a statement about the sector. On chiral members the Eisenstein content survives at EVEN n as well as odd, so the odd/even axis xB009 tested was NEVER the operative one -- CHIRALITY IS. F4 PASS, the lift control: realness is STABLE under exchanging the two lifts, so it is a property of the manifold and not of the choice. F5 PASS, AND IT CLOSES THE HOPE THIS ARC RAISED: F2 showed m004 as the UNIQUE member real at every n, 1 of 16, which looked like a SECOND SELECTOR -- arithmetic where xB007's only one (H_1) is homological. But m004 is also the only H_1 = Z member of its class, so realness might merely track knot-ness; testing other knot complements gives 6_3 AMPHICHIRAL AND REAL AT EVERY n, exactly like m004, while every chiral knot tested is complex. REALNESS TRACKS AMPHICHIRALITY AND KNOT-NESS, BOTH ALREADY IN THE RECORD; m004 IS NOT UNIQUE AND THIS IS NOT A NEW SELECTOR, so xB007's 'H_1 is the only selector' STANDS. A first draft of F3 printed 'chirality controls it' on the chiral column alone; the table does not support that and the claim was narrowed to the direction shown. CORRECTIONS LANDED ELSEWHERE: B425 SCOPED (its computations reproduced exactly and NOT disputed; its generality claim scoped to amphichiral), xB009 CORRECTED (m004 result stands, sector claim does not). Base rate outside this class measured only on the 10 knot complements of F5 -- a pattern without exception in 16 + 10 cases, not established as a theorem. Gate 5 absolute; no value, no generation count, nothing promotes.
